recipe.name: Chelonia — the carapace seal / investment / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Starting shrink allowance; confirm with the caster's alloy, wax and measured trials.

manufacturing.bench_notes: Lost wax on the factory 007 Quatrefoil, unmirrored. A hawksbill turtle swims across the table: its shell on the middle, a flipper on each lobe, its head down one along-ring cusp and its tail the other. Sprue from the palm. At the bench: clean the scute seams with a fine graver, leave the shell's plates bright and the flippers' scales satin.
